_about: Voice casting for Tembo and the Singing Spring. Stock Kokoro-82M voices only (Apache-2.0 weights and voice packs; no cloning). 'voice' is a stock voice or a blend of two stock voices' style vectors ('a:0.6+b:0.4'), chosen so the post-TTS pitch shift stays within +-2 semitones (the old casting shifted up to 5.6, which sounded robotic). pitch and rate are multipliers in animatica.audio.tts.VoiceSpec; delivery (pauses, breaths, *emphasis*, mood pace) is animatica.audio.delivery. Samples are [line, mood] from 04_screenplay.md, used by scripts/savannah_voices.py. Engine: Chatterbox (MIT) steered by each character's Kokoro take of its 'ref_text' (a neutral line that is not in the screenplay, so Chatterbox copies the voice, not a line's delivery); Kokoro is the fallback (DECISIONS #45).

narrator.note: warm storyteller, unhurried; Lewis adds depth and softens Fable's bright top
samples: Far away, where the grass grows golden and the sky goes on forever, the rains were late.
Fast or slow, tall or small... it takes *all* of us.
narrator.ref_text: Every morning the sun climbs over the hills, and the whole plain wakes up slowly, one sleepy animal at a time.

tembo.note: young elephant calf: eager, earnest, a little husky (a boy's register from a male+female blend, +1 semitone)
samples: Wait. We're not lost if we're *together*.
tembo.ref_text: I like mornings best, because that's when the mud is cool and everybody's still a bit sleepy, like me.

zuri.note: young zebra: quick, bright, a show-off
samples: That's the slow way. The grass is *faster*. Watch!
zuri.ref_text: I can run to the big rock and back before you've even finished saying hello. I timed it, you know.

kiki.note: meerkat lookout: fast, high, nervous, a touch prim (+2 semitones)
samples: She's gone. Nobody panic. EVERYBODY PANIC!
kiki.ref_text: I keep watch from the top of the mound every day. Somebody has to, and I'm very good at noticing things.

neema.ref_text: Sometimes I can see things far away, past the trees. But I don't always say so, in case I'm wrong.

bibi_kobe.note: old leopard tortoise: slow, low, kind, wise (-2 semitones)
samples: When I was young... there was a spring past the two baobabs that bow to each other.
When you walk *slowly*, you learn to look up.
bibi_kobe.ref_text: I have walked this land for a very long time, little ones. The grass remembers every path we take.
